verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API covers a broad core of the account. Documented endpoints span broadcasts (create, schedule, segment/tag targeting, stats, link clicks), custom fields with bulk updates, account details and brand colors, plus webhooks and a remote MCP server exposing subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. However, many UI features on the pricing page have no evidence of API equivalents, bulk processing covers only "some common use cases", and there is no explicit parity claim. Missing for 10: API coverage of visual automations, A/B tests, polls, landing page/form building, digital products, RSS campaigns and collaborative editing; an explicit UI–API parity statement; a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404); independent corroboration.
